title: Dam flooded the Egyptian labyrinth in the 1960s

tellings.quote: What happened was they put up a dam and when they put up a dam to help the farmers out, they diverted the water and the water filled up this labyrinth.

plain: In the 1960s, the story goes, a dam built to help Egyptian farmers sent water into the Egyptian labyrinth, a vast ancient maze-like building, and flooded it. The podcaster Joe Rogan tells it to Michels, passing on what a man named Ben van Kerkwijk told him, and he points to the ancient Greek historian Herodotus and the Roman writer Pliny the Elder as the old writers who described the labyrinth. If it is true, a great ancient structure would be lying underwater and out of reach.
